note: Commits that fix the order: expectations first, then the engine. Times in US Eastern.

expectations.what: 65 cases, the shelf and expected verdicts

changes.what: Similarity compares product type, actives, finish and form with half credit for neighbouring values and unknown details; no flat score for sharing a category. A replacement must be the same product type.

Added conditioner, hair oil or serum, lip balm, kettle and toaster categories; where a sunscreen goes (face, body or both) became its product type, and a replacement must do the whole job of the item it replaces.
Store return policies corrected (CVS beauty takes opened items back; Target's opened-electronics rule) and the expectations they affected; engine unchanged.

corrections.what: The policy table said CVS may refuse opened beauty (it cited CVS's general returns PDF; the beauty section of CVS's return policy page takes it back with a receipt) and that Target takes opened electronics back for exchange only (Target's exchange-only list doesn't include electronics).
corrections.afterNote: c06 and c26 became missed skips: each overlaps only partly with something the shopper owns, and at a store that takes opened beauty back the engine leaves a partial overlap to the price rules. The engine was not changed to win them back.
